# SurrealDB

> > SurrealDB is a multi-model database designed for AI agents and modern applications, featuring SurrealQL query language, WebAssembly support, and SDKs for JavaScript, Python, Rust, Java, Golang, .NET, and PHP.

SurrealDB provides a unified database solution combining document, graph, and relational paradigms with built-in security capabilities and cloud deployment options. The platform includes comprehensive documentation, CLI tools, and the Surrealist UI for database management.

## Key Topics

- SurrealDB
- SurrealQL
- Surrealist UI
- Multi-model database
- JavaScript SDK
